name: Eviction filings by county and year (LSC Civil Court Data Initiative)
description: Eviction filings (cases) by county and month from the Legal Services Corporation's Civil Court Data Initiative Eviction Tracker, which collects residential eviction filings from state and local courts: 1,464 counties and 34 states and territories, January 2016 through September 2025. Each record carries the filings of every full calendar year the county reports, the last twelve months where all twelve are present, filings per 100 renter households, the poverty rate and the latest month against the county's own historical average. Counties carry the Census FIPS code. LSC's data are released under CC0 1.0. The states and territories in the file are the ones LSC reports; the US record totals a year or month only where every one of them reports it.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Eviction filings by county and year (LSC Civil Court Data Initiative) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963459

distribution.name: evictions.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: evictions.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: evictions-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in evictions-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to evictions.csv on id.

recordSet.name: evictions
recordSet.description: The records of Eviction filings by county and year (LSC Civil Court Data Initiative), one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, DC or territory, or US

field.name: level
field.description: county, state (states and territories LSC reports on) or us

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Eviction filings in the last twelve months where all twelve are present; otherwise the filings in the months LSC reports (unit says which)

field.name: months_reported
field.description: Months with a filing count in LSC's file

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the first month reported

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
